description: This file defines a React component named 'ModelDataTable' that renders a dynamic, sortable, resizable, and filterable data table using @tanstack/react-table and Tremor UI components. It manages table state such as sorting, column sizing, and visibility, and exposes the table instance to parent components via a ref.

classes.name: ModelDataTableProps
classes.description: TypeScript interface defining props for the ModelDataTable component, including data, columns, loading state, table reference, and default sorting.

methods.name: ModelDataTable
methods.description: React functional component that renders a customizable data table. It initializes and manages table state, exposes the table instance to parent via ref, and handles rendering headers and rows with sorting and resizing functionalities.
